title: Pokemon auto battler. Inspired by balatro/super auto pets/ battlegrounds
author: Intelligent_Wafer_84
selftext:
Hey everyone! I've been building a fan-made Pokémon autobattler called \*\*Pokémon Auto League\*\*, and it's finally at a point where I'd love for people to play it.

Play it free in your browser (it works on your phone too): https://pokemon-auto-league.masterpreece.chatgpt.site

\*\*How it works\*\*

\- Pick Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, or any other region, and Professor Oak gives you a starter that levels up on its own.  
\- Recruit wild Pokémon from the tall grass each round and build a lineup of 6. Your top Pokémon fights first.  
\- Collect copies of the same Pokémon to level it up and evolve it (3 copies for Lv 2, 7 for Lv 3). Each evolution lets you pick a new move and a trait.  
\- Battles play out on their own, Gen 3 style, with weather, held items, natures, critical hits and shinies.  
\- Build around team Styles from competitive play (Rain, Sun, Sand, Hail, Trick Room, Hazards, Setup and more), plus type synergies that reward a varied team.

\*\*The journey\*\*

\- A Gym Leader every few rounds, all 8 badges, then Indigo Plateau: the Elite Four back to back, and your rival waiting as Champion.  
\- Stops along the way: the Safari Zone, the Celadon Game Corner (you can still win Dratini), Mt. Moon fossils, the Day Care and trades.  
\- Win and your team goes into the Hall of Fame, where you can rewatch the final battle.

The Elite Four is meant to be tough. About 1 in 3 runs that reach them end with a Champion.

This is a free, non-commercial fan project. I'd really love feedback, especially on balance, which Pokémon feel too strong or too weak, and what you'd want added next. What's your best team?
